# Two-reviewer validation of the mechanism-attribution heuristic

<!-- generated by 26_two_reviewer_analysis.py; Reviewer 1 (G.Z.) = Mechanism_Validation_Review_FINAL_GZ_returned.xlsx, Reviewer 2 (Y.L.) = Mechanism_Validation_Review_FINAL_YL_returned.xlsx -->

Two co-authors independently adjudicated all 48 sampled events, each blinded to the label the heuristic had assigned.

## Inter-rater reliability

- Observed agreement: **40/48 = 83.3%**
- Chance-expected agreement: 15.2%
- **Cohen's kappa = 0.803** (bootstrap 95% CI 0.702–0.902)

## Heuristic accuracy depends on the reference standard

| Reference standard | n | Unweighted | Population-weighted (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Reviewer 1 (G.Z.) | 48 | 40/48 = 83.3% | 93.1% (84.1–99.6) |
| Reviewer 2 (Y.L.) | 48 | 36/48 = 75.0% | 89.8% (85.1–94.9) |
| Both reviewers concur | 40 | 35/40 = 87.5% | 94.9% (86.4–100.0) |
| Adjudicated, upper bound | 48 | 41/48 = 85.4% | 97.0% (92.7–100.0) |
| Adjudicated, lower bound | 48 | 35/48 = 72.9% | 85.9% (76.9–94.0) |

## Per-label precision

| Mechanism | Population share | Reviewer 1 (G.Z.) | Reviewer 2 (Y.L.) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `reinterpretation` | 33.20% | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| `new_submitter` | 18.30% | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| `conflict_emerged` | 23.18% | 83.3% | 100.0% |
| `conflict_resolved` | 6.87% | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| `batch_event` | 12.79% | 83.3% | 33.3% |
| `likely_schema_driven` | 2.57% | 66.7% | 33.3% |
| `likely_knowledge_driven` | 3.09% | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| `transition_ambiguous` | 0.02% | 33.3% | 33.3% |

| R0007 | CACNA1S | `likely_schema_driven` | `likely_schema_driven` | `likely_knowledge_driven` |
| R0010 | SLC12A3 | `likely_schema_driven` | `likely_schema_driven` | `likely_knowledge_driven` |
| R0013 | GPR101 | `batch_event` | `batch_event` | `transition_ambiguous` |
| R0023 | COL11A2 | `conflict_emerged` | `reinterpretation` | `conflict_emerged` |
| R0034 | KCNQ1 | `batch_event` | `batch_event` | `likely_schema_driven` |
| R0041 | KRAS | `likely_schema_driven` | `transition_ambiguous` | `likely_knowledge_driven` |
| R0042 | RAPSN | `batch_event` | `batch_event` | `likely_schema_driven` |

These require adjudication by discussion before a single consensus figure can be quoted. Until then the defensible reporting is either both reviewers separately with the kappa, or the bounds above.
